description: Apply damage directly to a combatant (bypassing attack roll). In worlds with Health and Wounds, damage that reaches 0 Health deals a Wound (rolled on the wound table), and `wounds` deals Wounds directly.

damageType.description: Kind of damage: picks the wound table in worlds with Health and Wounds (the world's default otherwise)

wounds.description: Wounds dealt directly, skipping Health (worlds with Health and Wounds)

name: apply_damage
